name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-lrclib
description: Search tracks on LRCLIB and fetch plain or time-synced (LRC) lyrics. No API key.

environmentVariables.name: LRCLIB_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Override the User-Agent sent to LRCLIB.

environmentVariables.name: LRCLIB_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 500, floor 200.

environmentVariables.name: LRCLIB_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error.
